test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sujoy starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 7 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km, takes a right turn and drives 4 km and stops at Point B. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
The Following directions are as follows:

1) Sujoy starts from Point A and drives 11 km towards the east.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24bcf3f9dd68ff1a6d597515ae922d2b4efd93e743769264e2a2cd7ee6c2bd78.png] 

2) He then takes a left turn, drives 5 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af3f2c9a336ca13f6108075eac6891d1135b239c5051d982466cfe2a7f8e29c1.png] 

3) He then takes a left turn, drives 7 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16fa3b40c17f0290c1708596a3aedfe0dfbb05c6a3a059526d4761715e98b4d0.png] 

4) He then takes a left turn and drives 13 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17e03c2ef5ae29c6bcf813c3fd467779ad729073cf63fb0976c8600f0f9ab83b.png] 

5) And then he takes a right turn and drives 4 km and stops at Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e37d5ea38f5babb9c48ac3712736b60a8400afd4f657c5a1cebfc9d4feb5ab.png] 

So the final postion of Sujoy is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f47da34153639643feb3ee5bdf9a7998dee514f113ddf8a1fab0d55ff361f7e4.png] 

Therefore, Sujoy has to drive** 8 Km** towards** North direction** to reach** Point A from Point B.**

** **Hence, the correct answer is** "8 km towards the north****".**
